elements.element: Customer is not subject to any restriction on soliciting the other Party’s employees or personnel.
elements.evidence: The redlined clause expressly prohibits Customer, as one of the Parties, from knowingly soliciting certain personnel of the other Party.
The restriction applies to “neither Party” and covers personnel of “the other Party.”

elements.element: The restriction applies only to personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: The clause is limited to personnel “who were directly involved in performing or receiving the Services.”

elements.element: The restriction lasts 12 months from the end of each individual’s involvement in the Services.
elements.evidence: Although the clause references twelve months after an individual’s involvement ends, it separately applies “during the term.” If an individual’s involvement ends more than twelve months before the term expires, the restriction can continue beyond twelve months from the end of that individual’s involvement.

elements.element: The restriction does not apply to general advertisements.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly excludes general advertisements, untargeted recruitment campaigns, and untargeted recruiter use, including hiring persons who respond to them.

elements.element: The restriction does not apply to unsolicited approaches by personnel.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly permits hiring a person “who approaches a Party on their own initiative.”

elements.element: Neither Party is prohibited from hiring or employing the other Party’s personnel.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states that “neither Party is subject to any no-hire obligation.”

result.reason: The redline rejects the preferred position because it retains a non-solicit binding Customer. It substantially implements the fallback, including mutuality, direct-involvement scope, carve-outs, and elimination of the no-hire, but the independent phrase “during the term” can extend the restriction beyond twelve months after an individual’s involvement ends. The fallback duration is therefore not fully met.
